pages.title: Privacy and site information | LZZ Precision
pages.text: Privacy and site informationHow inquiry drafts are stored and how to use the product information on this site.Your inquiryThe inquiry form creates an email draft in your browser. It does not send your information to LZZ or upload drawings. To contact us, open the draft in your email app, add your attachments and send it yourself.Saved draftsYour input is kept in this browser tab so you can continue after a refresh. The draft is associated with the part or topic used when you entered the form. Changing the product or service inside the form updates that same draft; it does not create a separate saved copy. These details are not sent to LZZ or saved to an account.Select “Clear saved input” to remove the draft for the current entry context, including older copies associated with that entry. A browser that restores an earlier session may also restore your draft. Clear your input when using a shared device.If storage is blocked or full, you can still prepare a draft while the page is open, then choose “Save draft” to keep a text copy.Cookies and external servicesThis site does not use analytics or advertising cookies. Your email provider, WhatsApp and other linked websites have their own privacy policies.Product and company informationProduct pages describe example parts and the information needed to quote a similar component. They are not independently verified specifications for the pictured parts. Your drawing and quotation define the material and tolerances, with inspection and commercial terms confirmed for your order. Original catalog records are retained in our archive.The engineering guides help you prepare an inquiry. They contain no customer inspection results and do not establish suitability for a particular application. English summaries explain the company documents; contact LZZ to verify their current validity. Inspection planning is agreed for your order.ContactHangzhou Lizhizao Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. For questions about this site, contact roger@lzz-cnc.comUpdated 15 October 2026.

We are an ISO 9001 certified OEM partner specializing in high-precision CNC Milling and 5-Axis machining services. We transform your complex 2D/3D designs into finished metal and plastic components for sectors like Analytical Instruments, Automotive, and Robotics. Focused on tight tolerances and complex geometries, we offer flexible 1-piece MOQs and full supply chain support for B2B procurement managers worldwide.

Your Dedicated Manufacturing Partner for Precision CNC Milling

As a specialist CNC manufacturing factory with 15 years of industry experience, we understand that B2B procurement demands more than just manufacturing capacity—it requires reliability, quality certification, and partnership. Our CNC Milling services are engineered to meet the stringent demands of high-stakes industries globally.

Core Milling Capabilities:

  • Axis Capabilities: Full-spectrum services including 3-Axis, 4-Axis, and advanced 5-Axis Machining.

  • Complex Geometries: We excel in machining components with deep cavities, multi-angled features, contoured surfaces, and tight-tolerance bores—ideal for instrument enclosures and critical functional parts.

  • Material Versatility: We routinely process Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Carbon Steel, Copper, Brass, Titanium, and various Engineering Plastics.

  • Surface Finishes: Standard 'As-Milled,' polishing, bead blasting, anodizing (Type II/III), plating, and custom finishes to meet aesthetic and functional requirements.

catalog.description: We are an ISO 9001 Certified Manufacturer specializing in high-precision CNC Milling services. Our core expertise lies in transforming intricate 2D/3D blueprints into fin
catalog.html:
We are an ISO 9001 Certified Manufacturer specializing in high-precision CNC Milling services. Our core expertise lies in transforming intricate 2D/3D blueprints into finished parts, including complex blocks, brackets, and multi-featured housings. We are a reliable partner for OEMs in the Laboratory Instrument, Hydraulic Tools, and Custom Automotive industries, offering flexible production from 1-piece MOQs to large-scale batches.

Milling Excellence: Your Partner for Complex CNC Machined Components

As a dedicated CNC Milling Manufacturer, our facility is equipped with 40+ state-of-the-art machines designed to handle the most challenging part geometries your engineers can design. We understand that in the B2B world, the quality of a milled component directly affects the reliability and performance of your final assembly.

 

Core CNC Milling Capabilities & Technical Assurance:

 

  • Process Focus: Specializing in 3, 4, and 5-Axis CNC Milling to produce non-rotating components such as manifolds, valve bodies, structural brackets, and precise instrument housings.

  • Precision and Tolerances: Committed to achieving tight dimensional and positional tolerances required for critical interfaces in analytical equipment and hydraulic systems.

  • Quality Commitment: Our ISO 9001 Quality Management System includes a mandatory Four-Stage Inspection Process (First Article, Patrol, Final, Pre-shipment) ensuring 100% adherence to your engineering drawings.

  • Capacity & Flexibility: Capable of producing 100,000 components monthly. We support client requirements from prototyping (1-piece MOQ) to full production runs, ensuring scalability and efficiency.

 

Why Choose Us as Your OEM Milling Partner:

 

  • Experience: 15 years in the industry, with specialized focus on high-reliability applications (Lab Instruments, Fire & Rescue).

  • Supply Chain Simplification: Full OEM/ODM support, including reverse engineering. We provide protective packaging (foam, wooden crates) and offer DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) shipping via major global carriers.

  • Warranty: We provide a 6-month product warranty on all milled components.

Ready to start your next complex milling project? Send us your technical drawings and material specifications for a consultation.

catalog.description: We are an ISO 9001 certified OEM/ODM provider specializing in Ultra-High Precision Machining. This service is dedicated to projects where sub-micron tolerances, demanding
catalog.html:
We are an ISO 9001 certified OEM/ODM provider specializing in Ultra-High Precision Machining. This service is dedicated to projects where sub-micron tolerances, demanding surface finishes, and complex multi-axis geometries (such as impellers and advanced housings) are essential. We partner with leaders in Aerospace, Scientific Instrumentation, and High-End Robotics to solve the industry’s toughest design and manufacturing challenges.

Where Tolerance Meets Trust: Achieving the Unmachinable

In the realm of high-stakes product development, "Precision" is not a feature—it is the foundation. Our Precision Machining service is specifically tailored for clients whose components—like advanced turbomachinery or critical sensor enclosures (as pictured)—cannot afford dimensional variance. We specialize in components that others deem too complex or too difficult to hold tolerance on.

 

Key Pillars of Our Precision Commitment:

 

  • Mastery of Multi-Axis Machining: Our core strength lies in leveraging true 5-Axis continuous machining to produce parts with contoured surfaces, deep pockets, and complex internal features (such as the impeller blade geometry), often requiring a single setup to minimize error accumulation.

  • Tolerance Certification: We consistently hold and verify geometric and dimensional tolerances tighter than ±0.01mm (down to sub-micron levels), utilizing advanced metrology equipment and climate-controlled inspection areas to maintain accuracy.

  • Material Integrity: Specialized knowledge in machining high-performance alloys (e.g., Titanium, Inconel, hardened Stainless Steels) that are often required for lightweight, high-temperature, or high-pressure precision applications.

  • Surface Criticality: Dedicated finishing processes (lapping, polishing, specialized coatings) to achieve ultra-smooth Ra values required for optical, fluid dynamics, and critical sealing surfaces.

catalog.html:
As an ISO 9001 Certified OEM Partner with 15 years of manufacturing expertise, we provide comprehensive Precision Machining Solutions tailored for highly demanding industries (e.g., Analytical Instruments, Hydraulic Rescue Tools, High-End Automotive). Our service seamlessly integrates 5-Axis Milling, CNC Turning, and multi-axis processing to deliver parts with exceptional geometric complexity, ultra-tight tolerances, and superior surface integrity. We are your reliable source for custom components, starting from 1-piece prototyping.

Engineering Without Limits: Integrated Precision Machining for Global OEMs

Our Precision Machining Service is the definitive solution for engineering challenges that require a blend of complex processing capabilities. The components pictured demonstrate our ability to execute highly demanding designs, ranging from large-diameter critical ring housings with numerous internal features to small, angled components with integrated threads, all while adhering to the most stringent technical specifications.

 

Integrated Technical Capabilities:

 

  • Multi-Process Mastery: We do not rely on a single machine type. Our strength is the controlled integration of:

    • 5-Axis CNC Milling: For non-orthogonal features, contoured surfaces, and complex block/housing production.

    • CNC Turning & Mill-Turn: For high-precision shafts, fittings, and angled cylindrical components.

  • Geometric and Tolerance Assurance: We are proficient in achieving and verifying sub-millimeter tolerances across different axes and interfaces. Our advanced QC procedures minimize cumulative errors in complex multi-featured parts.

  • Applications Focus: Our history includes supplying parts for applications requiring long-term reliability: Hydraulic systems, scientific analysis equipment, and performance vehicle components.

catalog.description: We are an ISO 9001 certified OEM/ODM provider specializing in the manufacturing of complex, multi-featured components through integrated CNC and 5-Axis machining. We exce
catalog.html:
We are an ISO 9001 certified OEM/ODM provider specializing in the manufacturing of complex, multi-featured components through integrated CNC and 5-Axis machining. We excel at consolidating numerous features (bores, threads, curved surfaces) onto a single component, offering high-reliability parts for instrument, energy, and defense sectors. We are ready to handle your most challenging geometric requirements.

Conquering Complexity: Single-Setup Manufacturing for Multi-Sided Parts

Our Precision Machining Service is specifically designed for components like the one featured (the blue multi-sided part), which require high feature density and precise angular alignment across multiple faces. We view complexity not as an obstacle, but as a commitment to excellence.

 

Key Advantages for Multi-Sided Components:

 

  • Eliminating Tolerance Error: We specialize in utilizing advanced 5-Axis technology and custom fixturing to complete components with numerous bolt patterns, angled ports, and internal contours all in a single setup. This technique is crucial for eliminating tolerance chain errors that occur when a part is repeatedly reclamped.

  • High Feature Density: We excel at integrating multiple critical functions—such as fluid flow channels, sensor mounting points, and structural support—onto a single, consolidated component, which is vital for system miniaturization and performance.

  • Geometric Assurance: Our process focuses on optimizing tool paths and minimizing human intervention to ensure every dimension on your multi-sided part is delivered with verifiable, repeatable precision, regardless of the material used.

 

Your Reliable B2B Partnership:

 

We are the manufacturing partner you need when the part’s geometric complexity requires capabilities beyond standard 3-axis machining. We provide full ISO 9001 quality records, 6-month product warranty, and technical consultation from DFM (Design for Manufacturability) review onwards.

If your part's complexity demands a single-setup solution, contact us to bridge the gap between complex design and reliable production.

catalog.html:
We are an ISO 9001 Certified Manufacturer specializing in High-Precision CNC Turning Services for cylindrical, conical, and complex rotary components. Our capabilities include standard turning, advanced live tooling (mill-turn), and high-volume production of shafts, fittings, flanges, and bushings. We serve OEM clients requiring superior concentricity, surface finish, and threading accuracy for fluid dynamics, instruments, and motor applications.

Concentric Perfection: High-Precision CNC Turning Solutions

Our CNC Turning Service is dedicated to achieving the highest standards of precision for your rotational components. In critical applications, the performance of a shaft, bushing, or fitting depends entirely on its concentricity, roundness, and thread integrity. Our advanced turning centers are maintained for maximum rigidity and thermal stability, ensuring your components meet their precise functional requirements.

 

Core Turning Capabilities & Technical Assurance:

 

  • Process Focus: Dedicated CNC Lathes and Mill-Turn Centers (Live Tooling) for integrated turning and milling operations, allowing us to produce complex parts (like those with off-center holes or side slots) in a single, accurate setup.

  • Accuracy Metrics: Special emphasis on achieving extremely tight tolerances on diameters, lengths, and runout (concentricity). Superior control over surface finish (Ra values) for sealing and bearing surfaces.

  • Component Range: Specializing in small to medium-volume production of high-value parts, including: Hydraulic Fittings, Motor Shafts, Flanges, Custom Bolts, and Threaded Housings.

  • Material Expertise: Expert handling of stainless steels, aluminum, brass, copper, and engineering plastics used for rotational parts.

catalog.name: Custom Rotary & Cylindrical Components
catalog.description: As a key supplier of Precision CNC Turning Services, we excel in integrated Mill-Turn manufacturing. This capability eliminates the need for multiple setups, significantl
catalog.html:
As a key supplier of Precision CNC Turning Services, we excel in integrated Mill-Turn manufacturing. This capability eliminates the need for multiple setups, significantly boosting efficiency and part quality for complex rotary components, fittings, and housings. Certified ISO 9001, we provide reliable B2B supply for high-demand applications across various materials, including challenging alloys like brass and stainless steel.

Driving Efficiency: The Power of Integrated Mill-Turn Machining

In today's B2B landscape, time and reliability are paramount. Our CNC Turning Service is driven by Mill-Turn Technology, which is the intelligent convergence of turning and milling within a single machine tool. This process innovation is your direct path to improved component accuracy and compressed lead times, especially for parts requiring both cylindrical forms and off-axis features (like holes, flats, or slots).

Key Advantages of Mill-Turn Integration:

 

  • Minimized Handling, Maximized Accuracy: By performing multiple operations (turning, drilling, threading, milling) without removing the component from the chuck, we virtually eliminate alignment errors and boost concentricity compared to conventional two-step processing.

  • Complex Features on Rotary Parts: Ideal for manufacturing components that require threads, precise external/internal features, and cross-axis drilling, such as specialized hydraulic fittings, sensor bodies, and complex flange connections (as demonstrated in the image examples).

  • Material Versatility: Proven expertise in machining a wide array of materials, from standard Aluminum and Stainless Steel to high-value alloys like Brass and Copper, ensuring optimized tool life and surface finish for each material type.

catalog.html:
We are an ISO 9001 Certified Manufacturer specializing in the high-precision production of turned functional components, including complex fittings, adaptors, couplings, and threaded parts. Our expertise extends across diverse materials (Brass, Stainless Steel, Aluminum) and rigorous threading and sealing standards. We serve B2B clients in fluid dynamics, instrumentation, and industrial equipment who require reliable, leak-proof components.

Threaded Reliability: Precision Turning for Critical Fluid and Mechanical Connections

For applications involving fluid transfer, high pressure, or critical structural joining, the accuracy of fittings, connectors, and flanges is paramount. Our CNC Turning Service is specifically engineered to ensure thread integrity, exact bore sizing, and flawless sealing surfaces. The components shown (e.g., hose barbs, threaded adaptors, multi-holed flanges) are core examples of our rotational expertise.

 

Key Focus Areas for Connectors & Fittings:

 

  • Threading Excellence: We guarantee precise adherence to various international threading standards (e.g., NPT, BSPT, Metric) crucial for leak-proof performance in hydraulic and pneumatic systems.

  • Material Diversity: Extensive proficiency in turning a wide range of materials required for corrosion resistance and strength, including Brass, Copper, Stainless Steel (300/400 series), and Aluminum.

  • Integrated Secondary Features: We seamlessly execute secondary features on turned parts, such as cross-drilling, milling flats, hex features, and complex internal grooves using our live tooling (mill-turn) capabilities.

  • Surface Integrity: Specialized polishing and finishing techniques for sealing surfaces to ensure compatibility with gaskets and O-rings, meeting the high demands of laboratory analysis equipment and industrial valves.

catalog.html:
We are an ISO 9001 Certified Manufacturer offering complete CNC Milling Solutions, taking your design from raw material to finished product, ready for assembly. Our expertise covers precise machining across a wide range of materials (Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Brass) and includes comprehensive in-house or outsourced surface finishing (e.g., Anodizing, Plating, Black Oxide) and final assembly prep. We deliver fully compliant components with excellent aesthetics and durability.

Beyond the Cut: Complete CNC Milling Solutions with Expert Finishing

In many applications, the final look and long-term durability of a milled component are just as critical as its dimensional accuracy. Our CNC Milling Service extends beyond the machine bed. We provide a full-service manufacturing pipeline that ensures material suitability and provides the necessary protective or aesthetic surface treatments your product demands.

 

Key Areas of Material and Finishing Excellence:

 

  • Material Versatility: We maintain specialized tooling and processes optimized for your desired metal:

    • Aluminum: Ideal for lightweight blocks and brackets (e.g., Anodizing, Chromate Conversion).

    • Stainless Steel: Crucial for corrosion-resistant housings (e.g., Passivation, Electropolishing).

    • Brass/Copper: Used for high-conductivity or specialized fittings (e.g., Plating, Polishing).

  • Integrated Surface Finishing: We manage the entire finishing process, ensuring seamless transition from machining to treatment, avoiding quality issues: Anodizing (Type II/III), Powder Coating, Black Oxide, Nickel/Chrome Plating, and specialized cosmetic finishes.

  • Final Assembly Prep: Components are delivered clean, deburred, and dimensionally inspected after finishing, ensuring immediate fit into your assemblies without further processing.

We deliver comprehensive solutions including multi-color electrochemical surface treatments and precise machining, suitable for industries where visual appeal and structural integrity are equally important.

Excellence in Form and Function: High-Precision Machining with Custom Aesthetics

Our CNC Milling Service is your solution for components that must meet rigorous geometric standards while also providing a superior visual presence. We excel at manufacturing parts with complex curves, critical mounting features, and streamlined weight-reduction profiles—all crucial for performance applications.

 

Key Strengths in Geometry and Post-Processing:

 

  • Precision Geometry Execution: Proficient in milling complex structural components (like brackets and frames) to achieve exceptional dimensional accuracy and parallelism. We ensure critical mounting points are flawlessly aligned.

  • Advanced Surface Treatment: We manage the entire finishing process, offering durable and attractive multi-color electrochemical treatments (e.g., anodizing, plating) that enhance both the component's corrosion resistance and aesthetic appeal.

  • Feature Integration: Expertise in executing complex features such as precise bore sizing, threading, and customized logo engraving directly onto the milled surface, ensuring a seamless, high-quality final product.

  • Customization Focus: We are fully equipped to support OEM/ODM projects that require unique geometry, specific color coding, and tailored packaging solutions.

catalog.name: High-Volume CNC Turning for Complex Internal & External Features
catalog.description: As an ISO 9001 Certified Manufacturer, we specialize in providing high-volume CNC Turning services for components that require maximum consistency and precision across co
catalog.html:
As an ISO 9001 Certified Manufacturer, we specialize in providing high-volume CNC Turning services for components that require maximum consistency and precision across complex internal and external geometries. Our advanced multi-axis turning centers are equipped to produce technically demanding parts, such as precision cores, bushings, custom sleeves, and valve components, ensuring perfect concentricity and critical feature integrity for large-scale sub-assembly needs.

Driving Scalability: Consistency in High-Volume Precision Turning

FOur CNC Turning Service is engineered for clients with a critical need for high-quantity components that cannot compromise on quality. The challenge in high-volume production lies in maintaining absolute precision from the first part to the last. We meet this challenge by deploying dedicated turning cells and Statistical Process Control (SPC) methodologies.

 

Core Turning Strengths for Demanding Production:

 

  • Complex Feature Integrity: We specialize in components requiring detailed internal features, such as multi-diameter bores, internal grooves, and critical sealing surfaces. We ensure the integrity of these hidden features is maintained throughout every production run.

We specialize in the precision finish machining of complex industrial castings. This product demonstrates our capability to handle large, intricate housings with challenging internal geometries. From rough foundry parts to final inspection, we provide a complete manufacturing solution, ensuring that mating surfaces, bearing bores, and mounting points meet the strictest engineering tolerances for global OEMs.

Turning Complex Castings into Precision Components

We act as a premier manufacturing partner for OEMs, providing high-precision CNC machining services for custom cast components. As illustrated by this housing unit, we excel at bridging the gap between raw casting production and final assembly. We take near-net-shape parts and perform critical finishing operations to transform them into fully functional, ready-to-install structural components.

Core Manufacturing Competencies:

  • Handling Complex Geometries: This component features intricate internal ribs and deep cavities that require advanced machining strategies. We utilize multi-axis CNC centers and custom fixturing to access hard-to-reach areas, ensuring that every feature is machined relative to the correct datums without compromising the part's structural integrity.

  • High-Precision Boring & Milling: For housings and enclosures, the accuracy of bearing bores and mating surfaces is critical. Our CNC boring and milling processes achieve micron-level tolerances on concentricity and flatness, ensuring perfect alignment for internal mechanisms (such as shafts or gears) and reliable sealing against leaks.

  • Material Versatility: Our machining facility is equipped to process a diverse range of casting materials. Regardless of the specific alloy grade used in your foundry process, we apply optimized cutting parameters to ensure smooth surface finishes and extend tool life, delivering consistent quality across production batches.

  • Rigorous Dimensional Verification: We understand that "almost" is not good enough. We employ CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machines) to verify complex geometric tolerances (GD&T), ensuring that the position of every tapped hole and the diameter of every bore strictly adheres to your technical drawings.

Engineering Precision into Complex Castings

At LZZ, we understand that a raw casting is only the starting point. Our core expertise lies in Precision Finish Machining, transforming robust cast structures (as shown in the product images) into ready-to-assemble critical components. Whether it is a transmission housing with intricate internal gears or a high-pressure pump body, we provide the manufacturing reliability that global OEMs demand.

Why Leading OEMs Choose LZZ for Casting Machining:

  • Handling High Complexity (Transmission & Fluid Systems): The components illustrated feature challenging geometries, including internal splines, reinforced ribbing, and multi-directional flows. Utilizing our fleet of 40+ advanced CNC machines, we execute complex milling and boring operations to process these features relative to precise datums, ensuring perfect alignment for gears and shafts.

  • Micron-Level Tolerance Control: For housings and enclosures, the fit is everything. We guarantee dimensional accuracy with tolerances as tight as ±0.01mm. Our rigid process control ensures that bearing bores are perfectly concentric and sealing surfaces are flat, preventing leaks and vibration in the final application.

  • Reverse Engineering & Development Support: Do you have a legacy casting part but no CAD drawings? We can help. Our engineering team, backed by 15 years of experience, offers Reverse Engineering services. We can scan your sample, generate 3D models, and reproduce the part with optimized machining strategies—ideal for replacement parts or system upgrades.

  • ISO 9001 Certified Quality System: We treat every batch with the same rigor, whether it is a single prototype (MOQ=1) or a shipment of 10,000 units. Our 4-stage quality control process—First Article Inspection (FAI), In-Process QC, Final QC, and Pre-Shipment Check—ensures that no defective part leaves our factory.

  • Complete Surface Finishing: We deliver ready-to-use components. For aluminum housings, we manage the entire finishing process, including bead blasting, anodizing (Clear/Black/Color), and laser engraving, ensuring your small batch looks as professional as a mass-produced product.

catalog.html:
As a flexible Manufacturing Supplier specialized in High-Mix Low-Volume (HMLV) production, we bridge the gap between prototyping and mass manufacturing. We provide cost-effective short-run CNC services for custom precision parts, ensuring strictly consistent tolerances across batches ranging from 10 to 1,000 units. Our ISO 9001 facility offers rapid turnaround and factory-direct pricing for market testing and pilot runs.

Scalable Manufacturing Solutions: Bridging Prototypes and Mass Production

In the industrial development cycle, finding a Manufacturer willing to handle Low-Volume Production with high-quality standards is a common challenge. We position our factory as your strategic partner for Short-Run Manufacturing. Unlike large-scale plants that demand high MOQs or small job shops with inconsistent quality, we offer a dedicated production line optimized for batch sizes from 50 to 1,000 units.

Core Manufacturing Competencies:

  • Batch Consistency & Process Control: The challenge of low-volume production is ensuring that the first part matches the last. We utilize standardized CNC programming, dedicated fixturing, and rigorous in-process inspection to guarantee 100% dimensional consistency across the entire batch. Whether it is a run of 20 or 200 parts, every component meets the same ±0.01mm tolerance standards.

  • High-Mix Low-Volume (HMLV) Expertise: Our facility is designed for flexibility. With 40+ CNC Machining Centers, we can quickly switch setups between different project types. This allows us to support clients with diverse product portfolios who need frequent, smaller shipments rather than massive inventory stockpiles.

  • Rapid Market Response (Pilot Runs): For products in the NPI (New Product Introduction) phase, speed is critical. We provide Rapid Manufacturing services that allow you to test your market with a pilot batch in as little as 7-10 days. This "Bridge Production" capability helps you validate designs and assemble initial units without committing to expensive hard tooling.

  • Factory-Direct Cost Efficiency: By sourcing directly from our factory, you eliminate intermediary markups. We optimize our machining paths and material usage specifically for small batches, providing a cost structure that makes low-volume customization economically viable for medical devices, automation equipment, and high-end instruments.

Service Specifications:

  • Flexible MOQs: Support from 1 piece to 1,000+ pieces.

  • Materials: Aluminum (6061/7075), Stainless Steel (304/316), Brass, Engineering Plastics.

  • Quality Standard: ISO 9001 Certified, full FAI (First Article Inspection) reports provided.

engineeringCases.title: Five-axis machining for multiple faces
engineeringCases.lead: Machining holes, side openings and contoured faces on a component held in a rotary setup.
engineeringCases.workpiece: Front-face holes and a curved side opening place machining features on different faces of this component. Define their relationship to a common datum.
engineeringCases.setup: The workpiece is held in front of a rotary assembly, with spindle access from above. Tool reach and clearance around the fixture need to be checked for each face before the machining sequence is confirmed.
engineeringCases.visible: The separate component photographs show machined pockets, contoured edges and repeated hole patterns.
engineeringCases.inspection: Identify common datums and mating features. Specify positional tolerances, surface requirements and the dimensional records you need. LZZ reviews achievable limits and the inspection method against the drawing.

engineeringCases.title: Turning followed by milling
engineeringCases.lead: A turned component returns to the machine for features that require milling.
engineeringCases.workpiece: Circular bodies combine central bores with additional milled features. The drawing needs to locate those features relative to the turned axis.
engineeringCases.setup: A turned part is located for a subsequent milling operation. Review the milled features relative to the turned datum before selecting the holding method and machining sequence.
engineeringCases.visible: The circular parts combine internal bores with machined details around their outer form.
engineeringCases.inspection: Specify the datum axis and critical diameters. Define hole or slot positions and any runout requirement, then agree the report format for approval.

engineeringCases.title: Two milling setups for one part
engineeringCases.lead: Two milling setups provide access to different faces of the same part.
engineeringCases.workpiece: This component requires two milling operations. Features reached in the second setup must retain their relationship to the surfaces established in the first.
engineeringCases.setup: The part is held in different orientations for the two operations. Choose locating faces that retain the required relationships and leave access for clamping.
engineeringCases.visible: The two setups expose different machined faces and features. Use the drawing to identify which dimensions link those faces and need checking after repositioning.
engineeringCases.inspection: Identify common datums and the dimensional relationships that must be retained between setups. Agree inspection points and acceptance records before production.

engineeringCases.title: Milling a pocketed enclosure component
engineeringCases.lead: Milling a recessed component with a circular pocket and mounting features.
engineeringCases.workpiece: A block-like body combines a circular recess with mounting features. Specify pocket depth, wall thickness and mating interfaces on your drawing.
engineeringCases.setup: The component is held beneath a CNC spindle. Pocket depth, internal corner radii and clamping surfaces determine tool access; these need review against the actual model.
engineeringCases.visible: The machined components combine recessed areas, flat faces and mounting details.
engineeringCases.inspection: Identify datum faces and mounting-hole positions. Specify pocket depths and any sealing or mating surfaces. Agree how critical dimensions will be measured and recorded.

engineeringCases.title: CNC milling for prismatic multi-feature parts
engineeringCases.lead: CNC milling of block-shaped components with multiple machined faces and openings.
engineeringCases.workpiece: For this block-shaped part, identify the locating faces first, then dimension the other features from them.
engineeringCases.setup: The part is held below the spindle to machine the accessible faces. For multiple orientations, we plan the locating datums and setup sequence from the model before quoting.
engineeringCases.visible: Several components share a similar block-shaped form, with machined faces and openings.
engineeringCases.inspection: Mark critical bores and hole patterns on the drawing, along with mounting faces and the positional relationships between features. Agree the inspection method and sampling plan, then confirm the report format.

engineeringCases.title: CNC machining a 29-inch display housing
engineeringCases.lead: A broad display housing with recessed faces, edge details and mounting features.
engineeringCases.workpiece: The workshop records identify this as a housing for a 29-inch display. The broad panels have slots and mounting features. The display size is separate from the enclosure dimensions, which must be specified on the drawing.
engineeringCases.setup: The panel rests across the machine table beneath the spindle, with access to the internal face from above. For a similar enclosure, we check support points and clamping areas before planning tool reach and the order of operations.
engineeringCases.visible: The panels have internal recesses, machined face patterns and narrow edge features. The paired view compares their two faces, while the workshop video provides a closer look at the overall form.
engineeringCases.inspection: Locate holes and slots from the mounting datums. Define panel flatness and mating-edge relationships on the drawing. Mark cosmetic faces and dimensions that apply after finishing, then specify the measurement records needed for assembly.
